scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Four-level unresolved contact stress, geometric support diagnosis, fixed-point control and contact-distance tails

regularization_audit.scope: Separate contact-distance regularization from fixed-mesh full-arm contact histories.
regularization_audit.limitations: Only barrier activation distance changes. Geometry, material, collision quadrature, friction, control, time step and held-initializer protocol remain fixed; each distance solves its own corresponding closure. Complete independent body/joint/fresh-step gates and each Coulomb bound are retained. This is one unresolved coarse spatial/contact setting, not spatial convergence, finite-footprint model validation, original approach/angular-history matching or a physical accuracy/cost operating range. Nonzero full regularized-contact torque is recorded, not projected away.

geometry_audit.scope: Check whether fixed-polyhedron refinement resolves the original contact geometry.
geometry_audit.limitations: Incident plane normals and the supporting vertex describe the fixed seed polyhedron, not a refined smooth egg. Normal-cone/support margins diagnose the geometric contact type; they do not prove a stress singularity or establish contact/pressure/continuum convergence. Unmodified fixed-geometry refinement remains a valid volume axis. A smooth-surface geometry axis is a separately declared approximation to the original physical geometry, not permission to tune rounding or replace raw maxima.

point_load_control.scope: Fixed two-point load control: raw extrema, compliance and localized test-work bounds.
point_load_control.limitations: Explicit concentrated loads, with unchanged force vectors and material/reference anchors across meshes; consistent free-body inertia relief is part of this declared linear control. No finite traction footprint is imposed. Localized virtual test work provides a compliance lower bound, not a fitted singular exponent. This is a point-load diagnostic, not resolved continuum-contact convergence or an accepted finite-area egg/Franka physical model. Global raw maxima remain unsmoothed.

wide_spatial_fields.scope: Compare solved Panda spatial refinements at fixed material probes and physical times.
wide_spatial_fields.limitations: Fixed polyhedral geometry and physical held points. Configurations, explicit pairwise varying discretizations and fixed-contact-boundary markers define each comparison; body refinement changes contact triangles unless that boundary is frozen. A collision-only sweep keeps the volume fixed. Fixed material-coordinate interior probes carry seed-volume diagnostic weights, not an exact continuum norm. Tensors use each solution's proper finite body frame; contact wrenches use the shared fixed reference origin. Complete nonlinear global peak lower/upper bounds are retained separately. Two spatial levels or an equal-constructor control do not establish a physical tail. Contact quadrature/regularization/CAD geometry/full-arm support matching and feedback/model/accuracy-cost remain separate required studies.

Contact-distance tails are scoped to one coarse setting. Tip geometry/mesh qualification and exact coarse payloads do not count live finer solves as accepted results.
